snippet.title: PlayStation - Aironauts (1999)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
You are inmate #M-722954 and you've volunteered from millions of prisoners worldwide to take part in the new ratings busting game show Aironauts. As your prison sentence exceeds your life expectancy and your tests were well above average, you're a perfect candidate for an Aironaut. Aironauts is a gladiatorial game show in which contestants battle for supremacy over the skies of some of the world's most infamous prisons. You have to gather as many wing tokens as possible to progress to the next arena on the circuit. If you complete all of the circuits and are victorious, then freedom is yours. A full pardon, a new identity and enough cash to keep you happy for the rest of your life.
